description: Rohrleitungen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by umweltportal.mv-regierung.de. Pipelines and passages are elements that differ in length and function: Passages are usually used for underpasses and rarely have a length of more than 20 m; Pipelines, on the other hand, are usually much longer and serve for ‘aboveground ...
